boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 131 wraps a figure-8 frame around a center orange `5` gate, with blue left-arrows, red right-arrows, and yellow down-arrows marking the only legal exit lanes. The lower-left blue `2` seal and upper red `3` block compete for the same corridor — slide the red `3` through the exposed lower-left lane too early and the `5` gate loses its only incoming path.
landmarks: Block Out Level 131 wraps a figure-8 frame around a center orange `5` gate, with blue left-arrows, red right-arrows, and yellow down-arrows marking the only legal exit lanes.
The lower-left blue `2` seal and upper red `3` block compete for the same corridor — slide the red `3` through the exposed lower-left lane too early and the `5` gate loses its only incoming path.
The board mixes Yellow, Green, Blue and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Feed the blue-star cluster through the left arrow before the 3 counter drops into the waist.
Save the red L-cluster for the right-arrow lane until the upper chamber is empty.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the top yellow arm rows and spend the center orange 5 gate without crossing the lower-left 2 seals.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Slide the lower-left blue-star cluster through the blue left-arrow lane while the waist is still narrow.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the center purple corridor to drop the red 3 counter block into the waist opening.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Feed the lower-left red L-cluster through the red right-arrow lane once the upper chamber empties.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Shift the remaining green vertical stacks toward the yellow downward-arrow exit at bottom center.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the last yellow, blue, and purple scraps in the bottom L-pocket for the board clear.

failurePoints: Touching the lower-left 2 seals before the center 5 gate clears, locking the waist.
Sending the red L-cluster through the right arrow before the upper chamber empties, blocking the downward exit.
